subject: Request: SIG/CAIQ evidence + IRP timeline for auth anomaly
messages:
From: Rachel Lin <security@leahtech.com>

Cc: leahtech-security+intake@leahtech.com
Date: Tue, 21 Oct 2025 08:22:00 +0000
Subject: Request: SIG/CAIQ evidence & IRP for recent auth incident

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this — LeahTech is running a quick supplier security review following the auth spike we saw last week. We need aid pulling together the SIG/CAIQ mappings and a minimal IRP packet we can consume for our audit. Specifically:

- Completed SIG questionnaire (spreadsheet) or a note of outstanding questions
- SOC 2-relevant evidence: retention windows, auth logs (sample), incident timeline if available
- High-level IRP (who to notify, escalation matrix, RTO/RPO if applicable)

Can you confirm availability to share a redacted timeline and evidence bundle by COB Thu (2025-10-23)? If there are gating legal/NDAs required for log samples, flag that and we can route accordingly.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Rachel
Rachel Lin
Security Operations Lead, LeahTech
security@leahtech.com

Thanks Rachel — looping in Marissa and Jonas from Security & Trust and Soojin on ops so we can coordinate artifacts and access.

Marissa / Jonas / Soojin — LeahTech has asked for SIG/CAIQ mapping + a minimal IRP packet and a redacted incident timeline for the auth spike they observed. Target is COB Thu 2025-10-23. Notes and asks below:

- SIG spreadsheet: they prefer a populated spreadsheet; if we can't fully complete it in time, a draft with flagged questions is acceptable.
- Evidence: sample auth logs (redacted), retention policy excerpt, change control entry for the weekend deploy, and any runbook references.
- Timeline: short, redacted timeline (UTC) showing detection -> containment -> mitigation -> customer notification (if applicable). No PII in the timeline.
- Access: we'll share a secure drive link; if they need an NDA/TOU for the logs we should surface that now.

Marissa, can you pull the evidence bundle and a first-pass SIG sheet? Jonas — can you confirm which telemetry snippets are safe to share (and produce an auth-telemetry-sample.txt)? Soojin — please create the secure share and a short README describing redaction rules.

I will own the reply to LeahTech and will include the bundle link and a short executive summary. If anyone needs additional approvals for extracts, call it out in the thread.

Karthik
Director, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Karthik / Marissa — thanks for the prompt turnaround. We received the bundle link and the SIG draft (I reviewed the first pass). Quick clarifying questions: 

- Can you provide an explicit statement of whether the auth anomaly resulted in any customer-visible data exposure? A short "No customer data exposed" statement is sufficient if true.
- For the auth-telemetry-sample.txt, can you confirm the redaction method used for user identifiers (pseudonymization vs. removal)? We prefer hashed identifiers.
- LeahTech's audit team also asked for a completed SIG spreadsheet for the sections tagged as "high" risk. If you can prioritize completing those rows by COB Thu, that would be ideal.

Next steps from our side: we'll triage the bundle this afternoon and follow up with a formal intake ticket if they need additional artifacts. Also, please provide the one-page postmortem summary when available — our audit wants a short summary of detection, containment, root cause, and remediation.

I'll leave this with Karthik to coordinate the final deliverables.

Best,
Rachel
